name: Bauernhof Huberbauer & Ferienwohung Kaiserblick
beschreibung: The farm Bauernhof Huberbauer in Ebbs also operates under the name Ferienwohnung Kaiserblick and is classified in the inn category. The holiday apartments offer splendid views of the Kaiser Mountains. The farm is actively managed and produces its own fresh farm goods. Accommodations are well suited for self-caterers and families. Its convenient location in Ebbs provides direct access to hiking and cycling trails. Combining traditional agriculture and warm hospitality under one roof, guests can truly experience daily life on an authentic Tyrolean farm.
